summary.name: Mullvad Browser
summary.one_liner: Mullvad Browser is a privacy-focused web browser built on the Tor Browser's anti-fingerprinting protections, meant to be used with a VPN.
use_cases: Browsing privately while using a VPN
Testing pre-release browser features as an alpha tester
Private browsing sessions that reset with one click
summary.what_it_does: The browser uses the same anti-fingerprinting protection as the Tor Browser but connects directly to the internet, with or without a VPN, instead of through the Tor Network. Private mode is enabled by default, so cookies, cache and history are not saved between sessions, and a reset button starts a clean session. All telemetry has been removed. It includes uBlock Origin as its only extension for blocking third-party trackers. An alpha version (16.0a14 at the time of the page) is offered for testing and can be installed alongside the stable version.
notable: Same fingerprinting protection as the Tor Browser, but without routing through Tor
Private browsing by default with one-click reset
No telemetry and uBlock Origin as the only bundled extension
Alpha channel can be installed side by side with stable
caveats: Designed to be used with a trustworthy VPN; the page says a VPN alone is not enough for perfect privacy
Alpha version may be broken and does not offer the same privacy and security guarantees as stable
Page lists Windows only; the awesome-mac listing is a separate reference
